{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Sorzus Syn's chronicle of the rise of the Sith Empire is the oldest text by many thousands of years. She was a Dark Jedi banished into exile following their failed war against the Jedi.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Sorzus Syn's chronicle''' was a chronicle kept by [[Sorzus Syn]] of the [[Exiles]] that focused on the formation of the [[Sith Empire]], and the history of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Purebloods]] since the reign of [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]].

==History==
During her reign, [[Sorzus Syn]] wrote the chronicle detailing how she and her ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[exiles]] went to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. It later found its way into the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], where the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] proceeded to jot down their notes on the subject. Mace also speculated upon reading about [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] that the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Sith]] that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] had [[Battle of Naboo/Legends#Duel in Theed|defeated]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] might have originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and dispatched a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] (possibly [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]) to investigate, and was intrigued at Sorzus Syn's account about the Sith Purebloods possibly diluting their own line to extinction due to crossbreeding. It was eventually acquired by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after accessing the Jedi Archives at the then-recently destroyed [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and included it among the [[Book of Sith]], and implemented some of his own notes on various parts, including the revelation that the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] Windu alluded to were in fact forgeries as a means of misinformation planted by the Sith. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], upon discovering the Book of Sith in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] and reading through it, later jotted down some of his own notes, specifically his confirming Syn's claim about a rush of wind and a discharge of electric energy at Sith power locations from a similar experience at the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
